verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt documents registering a webhook URL in the dashboard under /webhooks, real-time notifications for notarization events, named events such as `appointment.completed`, and HMAC-SHA256 signature verification for payloads. Together these make up genuine registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: a full event catalog, programmatic (API-based) webhook registration rather than dashboard-only, documented retry/delivery semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
